question: Select the most appropriate option to fill In blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**brainstorming.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is regarding the book on computers.
 
• In the sentence with blank 4, the blank will imply the adjective that will define the exercises.
 
• Now, among the given options, the words in option 2, 3 and 4 imply negative connotations.
 
 
• Thus, options 2, 3 and 4 will be eliminated.
 
 
 
• **The correct word to use is option 1.**
 
• **"Brainstorming" means generating ideas through group discussion and creative thinking.**
 
 
• It is a popular technique used in business, education, and creative fields.
 
 
 
• The goal of brainstorming is to generate a wide range of ideas that can be refined and developed into a final solution.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Superficial** means shallow or lacking depth.
 
• **Baffling** means confusing or puzzling.
 
• **Irrational** means not based on reason or logic.
